title: Dehydrocavidine alleviates lipopolysaccharide-induced acute liver injury by activating Nrf2 signaling pathway to inhibit hepatocyte ferroptosis.
authors: Liang, Hongbiao; Hu, Guizimeng; Yang, Dongmin; Song, Yuwei; Zhang, Peng; Chen, Tianqi; Zhu, Xiangrui; Li, Peiyi; Wang, Yuan; Huo, Xinmei; Wang, Xiaoyi; Zhang, Yi; Zhang, Yujie; Liu, Jian; Feng, Juan
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究天然化合物DC通过Keap1/Nrf2通路抑制肝细胞铁死亡以缓解脓毒症肝损伤，虽含分子动力学模拟，但核心是药物-蛋白互作与疾病机制，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Sepsis-induced acute liver injury (SALI) remains a major challenge with limited effective treatments. Although Corydalis saxicola Bunting (CSB) exhibits anti-inflammatory and hepatoprotective properties, its role in SALI remains poorly understood. PURPOSE: To identify the active components and molecular mechanisms of CSB in protecting against SALI. METHODS: In vivo LPS-induced rat liver injury and in vitro cytokine-induced HepG2 injury models were established, treated with CSB extract or dehydrocavidine (DC). A series of advanced techniques including ferroptosis PCR array, super-resolution stimulated emission depletion (STED) microscopy, assay for transposase-accessible chromatin with sequencing (ATAC-seq), cellular thermal shift assay (CETSA), surface plasmon resonance (SPR), molecular dynamics simulation, and site-directed mutation were employed to investigate the underlying mechanisms. RESULTS: DC significantly mitigated LPS-induced liver injury, microcirculatory disorder, and leukocyte adhesion. It also alleviated liver ferroptosis under LPS challenge. In vitro studies revealed that LPS-activated macrophages secreted tumor necrosis factor-alpha (TNF-alpha) and interferon-gamma (IFN-gamma), which triggered hepatocyte ferroptosis. DC countered this process by inhibiting the production of these cytokines and correcting cytokine-induced mitochondrial abnormalities in hepatocytes. Mechanistically, DC bound to Kelch-like ECH-associated protein 1 (Keap1) at arginine 415 (R415), disrupting the formation of the Keap1/nuclear factor erythroid 2-related factor 2 (Nrf2) complex. This enabled Nrf2 nuclear translocation and promoted antioxidant gene expression, thereby correcting LPS-induced redox imbalance in hepatocytes. CONCLUSIONS: In addition to inhibiting LPS-induced macrophage activation, DC activates the Nrf2 signaling pathway in hepatocytes to alleviate inflammation-enhanced liver ferroptosis. It provides potential therapeutic strategies for sepsis and Gram-negative bacteria-associated liver injury.
abstract_zh: 背景：脓毒症诱导的急性肝损伤（SALI）仍是重大挑战，有效治疗方法有限。尽管岩黄连（Corydalis saxicola Bunting, CSB）具有抗炎和保肝特性，但其在SALI中的作用仍知之甚少。目的：鉴定CSB保护SALI的活性成分及分子机制。方法：建立体内脂多糖（LPS）诱导的大鼠肝损伤模型和体外细胞因子诱导的HepG2损伤模型，并用CSB提取物或脱氢卡维丁（dehydrocavidine, DC）处理。采用一系列先进技术，包括铁死亡PCR阵列、超分辨受激发射损耗（STED）显微镜、转座酶可及染色质测序（ATAC-seq）、细胞热位移分析（CETSA）、表面等离子体共振（SPR）、分子动力学模拟和定点突变，以探究潜在机制。结果：DC显著减轻了LPS诱导的肝损伤、微循环障碍和白细胞黏附，并缓解了LPS刺激下的肝脏铁死亡。体外研究表明，LPS激活的巨噬细胞分泌肿瘤坏死因子-α（TNF-alpha）和干扰素-γ（IFN-gamma），触发肝细胞铁死亡。DC通过抑制这些细胞因子的产生并纠正细胞因子诱导的肝细胞线粒体异常来对抗此过程。机制上，DC与Kelch样ECH相关蛋白1（Keap1）在精氨酸415（R415）位点结合，破坏Keap1/核因子E2相关因子2（Nrf2）复合物的形成，从而促进Nrf2核转位并增强抗氧化基因表达，纠正LPS诱导的肝细胞氧化还原失衡。结论：除抑制LPS诱导的巨噬细胞激活外，DC还激活肝细胞中的Nrf2信号通路，以减轻炎症增强的肝脏铁死亡，为脓毒症和革兰氏阴性菌相关肝损伤提供潜在治疗策略。
